title: Document roles-required parameter for the JIRA gadgets plugin
description: A parameter has been introduced to control which permissions are necessary to display a gadget.     The parameter is called """"roles-required"""". The values that I know for it are:    ||Values||||Description||  |use||JIRA Users Permission|  |admin|JIRA Administrators|  |browse||Browse Projects|  |sysadmin||JIRA System Administrators|

title: Add a confirmation dialog display on the Click of Cancel Button
description: {panel:bgColor=#e7f4fa}   *NOTE:* This suggestion is for *JIRA Server*. Using *JIRA Cloud*? [See the corresponding suggestion|http://jira.atlassian.com/browse/JRACLOUD-23284].   {panel}  I cannot tell you how many times I have accidentally clicked """"Cancel"""" when editing an issue in JIRA. Since there's no confirmation dialog (with OK button default selected for fast keyboard response), I lose what I have entered in a comment or details section. Please, please add a Cancel confirmation dialog to the Cancel button.
